것.t: 것 needs a word before it: 제 것 (mine), 먹을 것 (something to eat). In speech it shortens to 거: 제 거예요.

운동하다.x: I work out at the gym every evening.

짓다.forms: 지어요 · 지었어요 · 지을 거예요 · 지으세요 (ㅅ irregular)
짓다.m: to build; to make (rice, clothes); to give (a name); to write (a poem)
짓다.e: Core idea 'create': 집을 짓다, 밥을 짓다, 이름을 짓다.
짓다.t: Before vowels the ㅅ disappears: 지어요, not 짓어요.

결정하다.m: to decide, to make a decision
결정하다.ex: 저는 내년에 한국으로 유학을 가기로 결정했어요.
결정하다.x: I decided to go study abroad in Korea next year.
결정하다.e: Literally 'decide and fix' — once it's settled, it's decided.
결정하다.t: Use -기로 결정하다 for 'decide to do': 가기로 결정했어요 = I decided to go. 결정 is pronounced [결쩡].

모집.x: I saw a help-wanted ad for part-timers at a convenience store.
모집.t: Common on signs: 직원 모집 means 'Now hiring'.

인상.ex: 처음 만났을 때 그 사람은 인상이 좋았어요.
인상.x: When I first met him, he gave a good impression.
인상.e: Literally 'stamped image,' the picture a person leaves in your mind.
인상.t: 인상을 쓰다 means 'to frown'; a different 인상 means a price increase.

인상.x: The employees asked the company for a pay raise.
인상.e: Literally 'pulling up'; the opposite is 인하 'pulling down'.
인상.t: A different 인상 means 'impression', as in 첫인상 (first impression).

신혼여행.x: The two of them went to Jeju Island for their honeymoon.
신혼여행.t: Pronounced [신혼녀행] — an extra ㄴ sound is added before 여.

발생.ex: 화재 발생 시에는 엘리베이터를 이용하지 마세요.
발생.x: In case of fire, do not use the elevator.

갈등.x: Conflict arose because my parents and I think differently.
갈등.e: Literally 'arrowroot and wisteria' — two vines twisting around each other in opposite directions.
갈등.t: Pronounced [갈뜽] with a tense ㄸ sound.

엄격하다.x: Our school's rules are very strict.
엄격하다.t: 엄격하다 fits rules, systems and people; 엄하다 is mostly used for strict parents or teachers.

혜택.ex: 학생은 할인 혜택을 받을 수 있어요.
혜택.t: Common pattern: 혜택을 받다 'to receive a benefit'; 혜택을 주다 'to give a benefit.'

휴학하다.m: to take a leave of absence from school
휴학하다.x: My older brother took a year off school to do his military service.
휴학하다.t: Pronounced [휴하카다]: ㄱ followed by ㅎ becomes ㅋ.

쫓다.m: to chase, pursue; to drive away
쫓다.x: The cat is running around the yard chasing a mouse.

시장 점유율.ex: 우리 회사의 시장 점유율이 작년보다 높아졌습니다.
시장 점유율.x: Our company's market share has risen compared to last year.
시장 점유율.t: -율/-률 = rate: 점유율, 증가율, 합격률. Use 율 after a vowel or ㄴ.

위법.ex: 허가 없이 건물을 짓는 것은 위법입니다.
위법.x: Constructing a building without a permit is illegal.
위법.t: 위법 is a formal legal term; in everyday speech 불법 is far more common.

불쌍하다.ex: 그 영화 속 아이가 너무 불쌍해서 울었어요.
불쌍하다.x: The child in that movie was so pitiful that I cried.
불쌍하다.t: Saying it directly to someone (너 불쌍해) can sound condescending; 안됐다 is gentler.

얼룩지다.m: to get stained, to become blotchy
얼룩지다.x: My white pants got stained because of kimchi juice.

연착.m: late arrival, delay (of a train, plane, etc.)
연착.x: It snowed a lot, so the train arrived 30 minutes late.
연착.t: Usually used as 연착되다; for a late departure, 지연되다 is more common.

굿즈.x: I stood in line at the concert venue to buy merch.
굿즈.e: From English 'goods'; in Korean it means fan merchandise.
굿즈.t: Typical items are photo cards (포토카드), slogan towels and light sticks. 공식 굿즈 = official merch.

떼창.ex: 콘서트에서 팬들이 떼창을 해서 정말 감동했어요.
떼창.x: I was really moved when the fans sang along together at the concert.
떼창.t: Korean audiences are known for singing along to whole songs, even in English, at concerts by foreign artists.

무력.ex: 정부는 무력 충돌을 피하기 위해 대화를 제안했습니다.
무력.x: The government proposed talks to avoid an armed clash.
무력.t: 무력하다 is a different word meaning 'helpless'; context tells you which 무력 is meant.

소집하다.m: to call, to convene, to summon
소집하다.ex: 사장은 오늘 아침 긴급 회의를 소집했습니다.
소집하다.x: The company president called an emergency meeting this morning.
소집하다.t: 회의를 소집하다 is the standard way to say 'call a meeting.'

왜곡하다.m: to distort, to twist, to misrepresent
왜곡하다.ex: 그 기사는 사실을 왜곡해서 독자들을 오해하게 만들었어요.
왜곡하다.x: That article distorted the facts and misled readers.
왜곡하다.t: Pronounced [왜고카다] — ㄱ plus ㅎ becomes ㅋ.

그윽하다.m: deep and quiet, secluded; rich, deep (of scent or eyes)
그윽하다.ex: 차를 마시자 그윽한 향이 입안에 퍼졌어요.
그윽하다.x: When I sipped the tea, a deep, rich aroma spread through my mouth.
그윽하다.e: A literary-feeling word for depth and stillness: 그윽한 눈빛 'a deep, soulful gaze'.
그윽하다.t: Pronounced [그으카다] — ㄱ and ㅎ merge into ㅋ.

탁상공론.ex: 현장을 모르는 탁상공론은 도움이 안 돼요.
탁상공론.x: Armchair theories from people who don't know the field are no help.
탁상공론.e: Literally 'empty arguments on top of a desk'.

까닭.ex: 그가 화를 낸 까닭을 아무도 몰랐어요.
까닭.x: Nobody knew the reason he got angry.
까닭.e: A more literary native word for 이유; common in writing and old sayings.
까닭.t: Pronounced [까닥], but 까닭이 [까달기] and 까닭을 [까달글] — the ㄹ comes back before a vowel.

외상.ex: 사고 후에 심리적 외상으로 오랫동안 힘들었어요.
외상.x: After the accident, I struggled for a long time with psychological trauma.
외상.e: Literally 'outer wound'. Homonym warning: 외상 also means buying on credit.
외상.t: PTSD is 외상 후 스트레스 장애; in casual speech many people simply say 트라우마.

놓이다.m: to be placed, be put; to be in (a situation)
놓이다.ex: 그 회사는 지금 매우 어려운 상황에 놓여 있어요.
놓이다.x: That company is currently in a very difficult situation.
놓이다.e: Passive of 놓다 (to put): 'to be put' somewhere, physically or in a situation.
놓이다.t: Pattern: [situation]에 놓이다 — 위기에 놓이다 means 'to be in crisis'.

보합세.ex: 오늘 주식 시장은 하루 종일 보합세를 유지했습니다.
보합세.x: The stock market held steady all day today.
보합세.e: Literally 'keeping level' — prices barely moving up or down.
보합세.t: Pronounced [보합쎄]; a market-news word meaning prices are basically unchanged.

귀가 솔깃하다.forms: 귀가 솔깃해요 · 귀가 솔깃했어요 · 귀가 솔깃한 (+noun)
귀가 솔깃하다.m: to find something tempting, to prick up one's ears (at an offer)
귀가 솔깃하다.ex: 월급을 두 배로 준다는 말에 귀가 솔깃했어요.
귀가 솔깃하다.x: When they said they'd double my salary, my ears pricked up.
귀가 솔깃하다.e: 솔깃하다 describes the mind leaning toward what it hears; the ear 'leans in' to an attractive idea.
귀가 솔깃하다.t: Pronounced [솔기타다]. Often about offers that sound too good to be true: 귀가 솔깃한 제안 'a tempting offer'.

음역.ex: 이 노래는 음역이 넓어서 부르기가 어려워요.
음역.x: This song has a wide range, so it's hard to sing.
음역.e: Literally 'sound territory'. Homonym alert: 음역 also means 'transliteration'.
음역.t: Pronounced [으멱]: the batchim ㅁ links over to the vowel of 역.

물경.m: no less than, a whopping (before a surprising number)
물경.ex: 그 그림은 경매에서 물경 백억 원에 팔렸습니다.
물경.x: That painting sold at auction for a whopping ten billion won.
물경.e: Literally 'don't be surprised': said right before a shocking figure.
물경.t: Old-fashioned; modern Korean usually says 무려 instead.

인구절벽.ex: 인구절벽으로 문을 닫는 학교가 늘고 있습니다.
인구절벽.x: More and more schools are closing because of the population cliff.
인구절벽.e: Literally 'population sheer cliff': numbers drop as if falling off a cliff.

성폭력.x: Systems that protect victims of sexual violence have been strengthened.
성폭력.t: Pronounced [성퐁녁]: nasalization turns ㄱ into ㅇ and ㄹ into ㄴ.

세대갈등.ex: 가치관 차이 때문에 세대갈등이 점점 심해지고 있어요.
세대갈등.x: Generational conflict is getting worse because of differing values.
세대갈등.e: Literally 'generations tangled like vines': 갈등 pictures twisted vines.
세대갈등.t: Pronounced [세대갈뜽]: ㄷ after ㄹ becomes tense in Sino words.

서식.m: inhabiting, living (of animals and plants); habitat
서식.ex: 이 습지에는 멸종위기종 여러 종이 서식하고 있어요.
서식.x: Several endangered species live in this wetland.
서식.t: Homonym: 서식 (書式) also means 'form, format' for documents.

도용하다.m: to steal and use, to misappropriate (an identity or idea)
도용하다.ex: 누군가 제 이름을 도용해서 계정을 만들었어요.
도용하다.x: Someone stole my name and made an account.
도용하다.t: Common in phrases like 명의 도용 (identity theft) and 아이디어 도용.

깃들다.forms: 깃들어요 · 깃들었어요 · 깃들 거예요 · 깃든 (+noun) (ㄹ drops)
깃들다.m: to dwell in, to be imbued with (spirit, feeling); to settle in (dusk, quiet)
깃들다.ex: 이 작품에는 작가의 정성이 깃들어 있어요.
깃들다.x: The artist's devotion dwells in this work.
깃들다.e: Probably from 깃 'nest' + 들다 'to enter' — something settling in as if into a nest.
깃들다.t: Don't confuse with 깃들이다 'to nest, to settle in' (birds, people); 깃들다 is for spirit, feelings, or dusk.

혼탁하다.m: murky, turbid; corrupt, chaotic (of society or politics)
혼탁하다.x: The river became murky because of factory wastewater.
혼탁하다.t: Pronounced [혼타카다]; also used figuratively: 혼탁한 선거 'a dirty election'.
